contexts.text: Thou shalt make fifty hooks of gold () = the plenary faculty of conjunction from good... Hooks = the faculty of conjunction; for the faculty of conjunction is in them from their form, which is that of what is bent back or curved in.
Thou shalt make fifty hooks of brass () = the plenary faculty of conjunction from external good.
Thou shalt give the veil under the hooks () = the faculty, and thence the actuality, of conjunction. Explained.
